resources.string: Sign in to keep your wallet tied to an identity, or explore the demo without an account.
No account needed. Every balance and payment stays simulated.
Use the email address or Hong Kong phone number you registered.
One identifier is enough: an email address or a Hong Kong phone number.

Use 8–128 characters with at least one letter and one digit (0–9). Symbols are optional. Avoid common passwords, the full part before @ in your email (if it has at least 3 characters), and your full international phone number.
This is a course prototype. No real money, bank account or Octopus connection is involved.
Enter the six-digit code we sent to %1$s.
Simulated delivery. A production build has a backend send this code by email or SMS; the app itself never holds provider credentials.
The code expires five minutes after it is issued.
We send a one-time code to the identifier on the account, then you choose a new password.
Enter the code sent to %1$s, then choose a password different from your current one.
Cards, balances, transactions and messages belong to the signed-in account.
Signing in with a different account shows that account’s cards and balance. The demo guest wallet is kept separately. Everything stays on this device.
The account and its one-time codes are removed from this device. Wallet data stays where it is.

On Home, tap Top up, choose a card and an amount (HK$50, 100, 200, 500 or your own), check the details and confirm. The money is simulated.
Tap Pay, choose a demo merchant and amount, check the details and confirm. A simulated receipt is saved in Activity.
The balance is on the home card. You can top up, or change the low-balance threshold in Settings.
Buy the demo monthly pass from Transport. The fee is taken from the selected card. It cannot be used for real travel.
On the sign-in screen tap Forgot password, then use the email or phone you registered. In this demo the code is shown on screen instead of being sent.
Freeze or unfreeze a card from Home. A lost card is an account matter: contact a person on WhatsApp 2520 1314.
Refunds, disputed charges, lost cards and account deletion are handled by a person. WhatsApp 2520 1314; the AI assistant cannot process them.
Settings → Appearance → Language switches between English, 繁體中文 and 简体中文 immediately.
Settings → Accessibility & elderly mode has large text, high contrast, read-aloud and a simplified flow.
Settings → Notifications chooses transactions, low balance, pass expiry, offers and service announcements. Every message stays in the inbox.
The sign-language page has written chapters for top up, payment, pass and password. This prototype ships without video footage.
Four chapters, each with written steps.
Sign-language support with four written chapters: top up, pay, pass and password.
This prototype does not include sign-language footage. Each chapter is a complete written transcript with a video slot; when the department supplies clips, the player enables itself.
1. On Home, tap Top up. 2. Choose the card. 3. Enter or pick an amount. 4. Check the details, then confirm.
1. On Home, tap Pay. 2. Choose a demo merchant. 3. Enter the amount. 4. Check the details, then confirm.
1. Open Transport. 2. Choose the demo monthly pass. 3. Confirm the fee. 4. The pass appears under Transport until it expires.
1. On the sign-in screen, tap Forgot password. 2. Enter your email or phone. 3. Read the code shown on screen. 4. Set a new password.
